description: Proshort is an AI-driven sales enablement and revenue intelligence platform that helps go-to-market (GTM) teams accelerate deal cycles and elevate rep performance through contextual AI agents and deep CRM integration. Reps can access snippets from top performers and launch personalized roleplay sessions to improve weaker areas. - CRM Agents Proshort’s CRM Agents keep deal data clean and updated automatically. They can create or update deals, contacts, or accounts, map meetings to opportunities, and sync AI-generated notes directly into CRM systems like Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or LeadSquared. They resolve mapping logic (e.g., which deal a meeting belongs to) intelligently, ensuring all data is properly attributed for accurate reporting and forecasting. - AI Notetaker Proshort automatically records and transcribes meetings (across Google Meet, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams) via a bot or a botless desktop recorder. It then generates structured notes that include summaries, action items, risks, pain points, and next steps. Notes sync seamlessly to CRM records and can be shared internally or externally through links or snippets. - Additional Features Meeting Preparation: Proshort creates pre-call prep cards with LinkedIn profiles of attendees, company overviews, funding info, product summaries, financials, key decision-makers, and recent meeting/email summaries. Ask Me Anything (AMA): Users can ask natural language questions at the meeting, deal, or organization level — just like ChatGPT — but with contextual access to deal data. Smart Deal Insights: Detects stalled deals, missing buyers, weak top-of-funnel signals, or long inactivity. Win/Loss Analysis: AI-generated summaries of why deals were won or lost, across factors like rep performance, product fit, competition, and buyer sentiment. Playbooks & Battlecards: Automatically clusters objections and competitor mentions, generates summarized best responses, and surfaces real snippets from top-performing reps. Learning & Training: Built-in LMS where admins can create AI-powered courses with video, PDF, and quizzes. Quizzes are automatically generated from the learning content. Manager Dashboards: Aggregate views of rep performance across revenue, skill scores, deal health, and sentiment distribution — helping managers coach strategically. - Summary Proshort combines AI agents, CRM automation, and conversation intelligence into a single unified platform for modern revenue teams. It doesn’t just tell you what’s wrong with a deal — it also tells you what to do next, automating insights into next steps, training, and deal execution.
